description: This file defines a Go struct and associated methods for configuring a declarative 'ObjectReference' used in Kubernetes API apply configurations. It includes fields for referencing Kubernetes objects and provides builder methods for setting these fields.

classes.name: ObjectReferenceApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A struct representing a declarative configuration for Kubernetes ObjectReference, with pointer fields for optional values and builder methods for setting each field.

methods.name: ObjectReference()
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of ObjectReferenceApplyConfiguration.

methods.name: WithKind
methods.description: Sets the 'Kind' field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithNamespace
methods.description: Sets the 'Namespace' field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Sets the 'Name' field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithUID
methods.description: Sets the 'UID' field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithAPIVersion
methods.description: Sets the 'APIVersion' field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithResourceVersion

methods.name: WithFieldPath
methods.description: Sets the 'FieldPath' field in the configuration.
